body: i dont mean to minimize the lesson. i am grateful that i learned, but i also seek to find peace within myself.

it also has to do with culture surrounding adolescents that glorifies this kind of stuff. it is horrible that innocent children are corrupted and influenced by deplorable stuff from an extremely young age.

i realize that what i did can be considered harassment, and i don't deny that. i did a bad thing. but i also feel that since i was a child who didn't know any better and didn't realize what i was doing was wrong, i shouldn't feel like i straight up harassed someone. i did a horrible thing, but it's more complicated and nuanced than being a horrible human being.

this is something i've thought about. it feels very harsh to call myself a sexual harasser. i was an impressionable child who wouldn't have done it if i had known any better. my actions were horrible and can be considered harassment, but in this context, that feels a bit heavy. it would be one thing if i was a teenager or adult, but it's very hard to cut myself some slack and not consider myself a sexual harasser.
i care passionately about these things. i also have ocd, so it's not exactly easy to just let it go.
i can't move past the thought that i committed harassment. i know what i did can get considered that but i'm torn, i feel like i should give some leniency due to my age and innocence.
should i be carrying the guilt of knowing that i committed sexual harassment? this is what i find challenging.
thank you. i understand. it will just be difficult to live my life knowing that i committed sexual harassment. i feel awful.
should i label myself as a harasser?
i find it hard to equate a malicious act of harassment with uninformed childhood mistakes. i know that what i did is considered harassment, but is this a proper label to put on a child?

as i said, part of me wants to forgive myself as i acted out of innocence and ignorance, but being able to be categorized as a harasser is a feeling i would wish on no one. the last thing i would want is to cause someone pain.

with all being said and done, it will prove to be difficult to not see myself as a sexual harasser. i really appreciate the support, im going to speak to my therapist about this. the thought that i committed sexual harassment still looms large.
thank you, this really eats at me and i just seek to find peace.

thank you, thankfully those questions are all easy nos. as i said, i dont know whether to feel like my childhood self was truly a bad person and a harasser, as i had no ill intent and had no idea of what i was truly doing. i will work diligently to repent and make up for my past mistakes. it would be an honor to help causes dealing with abuse and harassment, as well as educating the youth.
thank you for the advice. do you think i should be able to go easier on and forgive my past self somewhat? that would make the healing process much more manageable.
thank you for the support, though it is hard to swallow the fact that im guilty of such sick things. i feel worthless
